We are looking for a passionate and customer-obsessed Associate Product Manager to join our Personal Loans team. If you love talking to customers, obsess over removing friction, and want to build financial products that make a real difference in people's lives — this role is for you.

* Own end-to-end onboarding and integration of new lending partners onto our platform, working closely with engineering, operations, and business teams.

* Identify friction points in the funnel using data and customer feedback, and work with engineering and design to ship fixes fast.
